stage.LAUNCH.aim: Be visible and earn your first ratings, on a thin but positive margin.
stage.RAMP.aim: Step the price up ₹10–20 a week and keep what works.
stage.MATURE.aim: Hold the price the steps found. Do not match an undercut on reflex.
stage.DECLINE.aim: Clear the stock down a markdown ladder that stops at your floor.
home.title: Sahi Daam
home.lead: Offline sellers price the way they did in their shop: cost plus a markup. Online, the orders that never arrive cost you just as much as the ones that do — and nobody shows you that number.
home.hookCaption: A ₹300 kurti costing ₹150. Out of 100 orders dispatched, 17 never reach the buyer and 13 come back — and you pay shipping, packaging and COD handling on all of them.
home.card1.title: Price any product
home.card1.body: Your true floor from your own cost, RTO and returns — then the market band beside it, with a recommendation for every stage of the product’s life.
home.card2.title: Follow a seller’s journey
home.card2.body: 26 weeks of one kurti, priced two ways on the same market. Same stock, same festive season — and ₹79,566 between them at the end.
home.card3.title: See what changes
home.card3.body: What Meesho shows a seller today, next to what Sahi Daam adds — and every number in this prototype with the source it came from.
home.builtBy: Team Taraazu · Meesho DICE Challenge 3.0 · Problem statement 4
compare.title: Meesho today vs Sahi Daam
compare.lead: Meesho’s Recommended Price Range already tells a seller what similar products cost. It does not know what this seller’s product costs them, how much of it comes back, or where the product is in its life.
compare.todayRange: Recommended price range {from}–{to}, based on similar products.
compare.check.stage: Where the product is in its life
compare.atMidpoint: At the middle of Meesho’s range
compare.atBottom: At the bottom of Meesho’s range
compare.atTop: At the top of Meesho’s range
compare.stageHeading: And a price for every stage
compare.watchBody: Six triggers run every week. When returns climb, when festive RTO lifts your floor, when a competitor cuts, when your cost moves — you get a WhatsApp with the new number in it.
compare.noAlerts: Nothing is firing right now for this product — your price clears your floor and the season is quiet.
floor.lead: Meesho charges 0% commission, so your costs are flat per order — and you pay them on orders that never become a sale. Here is the lowest price that still leaves you whole.
floor.headline: Your true floor — below this you lose money on every sale
floor.enterPrice: Enter a planned price below to see what you think you earn against what you actually earn.
floor.meeshoFillsHint: Meesho knows these from your account, your region and your category.
floor.whatIfHint: Drag these and every number above updates live.
floor.scenarioHint: Returns are a range, not a number. Pick which end the tables below should show.
floor.funnelHint: Where the orders go. The flat costs are paid on all 100.
floor.costTableHint: Every rupee of overhead on 100 orders dispatched, then spread over the sales that survive.
floor.overheadBarsHint: Each surviving sale has to carry this much on top of your product cost.
floor.sourcesNote: Shipping slabs, COD share and RTO rates are from the Valmo DICE data pack. The COD fee, GST treatment, packaging and category return rates are marked ASSUMPTION. Every value and its source is on the Numbers & sources screen.
auth.pitch: Tell us a little about your shop once, and every number after that is yours — your cost, your buyers, your returns. Not a category average.
auth.why1: Where your buyers live decides how many parcels come back — and that moves your floor more than anything else.
auth.why2: Your cost and your parcel weight pick the shipping slab you actually pay.
auth.why3: Answer once and Aapki Laagat opens already filled in.
auth.warningBody: There is no server. Accounts are kept in this browser only, the password is not securely hashed, and anyone using this device can read them. Please do not reuse a real password.
auth.error.noAccount: No account with that email. Try signing up, or use one of the demo logins below.
auth.error.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.taken: There is already an account with that email.
onboard.title: A few questions, once
onboard.lead: Everything you answer here fills in a field you would otherwise have to guess at. You can change any of it later.
onboard.aboutYouHint: Your name goes into the alerts you receive.
onboard.aboutProductHint: This picks your shipping slab, your return rate and your packaging cost.
onboard.qCategoryHint: Sets the return rate and packaging Meesho expects for this kind of product.
onboard.qCogs: What does one piece cost you?
onboard.qCogsHint: What you pay your supplier, not what you sell at.
onboard.qWeightHint: Packed and ready to ship. This picks your shipping slab.
onboard.aboutBuyersHint: This is the one that moves your floor most — COD orders are refused far more often.
onboard.qBuyers: Where do most of your buyers live?
onboard.qPrepaid: Do you offer a discount for paying up front?
onboard.qPrepaidHint: Even a small one moves about a tenth of your orders off COD.
onboard.qOrders: About how many orders a week?
onboard.qOrdersHint: A rough number is fine. It is only used for stock planning.
onboard.previewNote: This is the real calculation, not a guess — it updates as you answer.
onboard.filled: What this fills in for you
onboard.filledHint: You would have had to guess at every one of these.
onboard.finishDisabled: Fill in your name and cost to continue
admin.title: Platform defaults
admin.lead: These are the numbers Meesho fills in on every seller’s behalf. Change one and every seller’s floor moves with it — the table shows by how much before you apply it.
admin.defaultsHint: Applies to every seller on the platform.
admin.codFeeHint: Charged per COD order, whether or not it is delivered.
admin.gstRateHint: Applied to the forward leg only.
admin.readOnlyNote: Shipping slabs, season indices and per-category return rates are read-only in this prototype.
admin.noSellers: No sellers have signed up yet.
admin.impactNote: Each floor is computed with that seller’s own category, cost, weight and buyer mix — the same engine the seller sees.
admin.dangerHint: Clears every account in this browser and restores the two demo logins.
admin.resetConfirm: Delete every account stored in this browser and restore the demo logins?

assumptions.lead: Every configuration value in this prototype, with where it came from.

assumptions.search: Search a value, a unit or a source
